overview: Sing is a 2016 American animated musical comedy film written and directed by Garth Jennings. Produced by Universal Pictures and Illumination Entertainment, the film stars the voices of Matthew McConaughey, Reese Witherspoon, Seth MacFarlane, Scarlett Johansson, Leslie Jones, John C. Reilly, Taron Egerton, and Tori Kelly. Set in a world inhabited by anthropomorphic animals, the film focuses on a koala named Buster Moon (McConaughey), a struggling theater owner who stages a singing competition in an effort to stop his theater from entering foreclosure, as well as how the competition interferes with the personal lives of its contestants.
